_notes._: Copy this file to 'config.json' (without the .example) and edit it. config.json is gitignored, so your paths stay on your machine.
_notes.roots: Each media type is a list of named roots, one per drive. 'name' becomes a folder under output/, cache/ and ignored/, and is how you pick a drive: npm run movies external. Leave the drive off to use the first root.
_notes.unused_types: Leave out any media type you don't have — at least one must be listed. Commands skip unconfigured types.
_notes.probe_concurrency: Optional per root: how many files the first scan inspects at once. Default 1 suits spinning disks; SSDs and network shares are usually much faster at 4-8.
_notes.plex: Optional. Only the plex:* commands use it. The token goes in .secrets.json, not here. See docs/PLEX.md.
